paragraphs: Sub Objective 1.1: This is an externally sponsored project; therefore, the project requirements and tools are mainly decided by the sponsoring agency.
Sub Objective 1.2: The student is contributing to the external project via GitHub. According to the course facilitator’s observations, the student’s contributions are at a satisfactory level.

Sub Objective 2.1: Since the project started a little late, it is too early to determine whether the justification of tools and technology selection is appropriate. However, these aspects will be evaluated in the final PDR.
Sub Objective 3.2: The student uses GitHub projects to manage the project and relies on official channels, including Teams and in-person meetings, for communication.
Sub Objective 3.1: According to the facilitator’s observations, the student maintains a healthy relationship with team members, which contributes to better productivity.
Sub Objective 3.3: The final report should be comprehensive, covering all aspects of the project, including both user documentation and technical documentation
Report: The report has not been submitted yet.
Decision: According to the mid-PDR evaluation. The current progress of the student is satisfactory.
Report: Diagrams, such as flow diagrams, supported by clear explanations, would make the content easier to follow and help the reader understand the project more effectively.
Report: All the images should have captions, and each image should be explained in the main text.
Report: Any images taken from other sources must be acknowledged appropriately.
Decision: Strong attention to implementation is required to achieve the learning objectives.
